name: project-aegis
description: Project AEGIS — multi-agent AI system core. Phase 0–1: task lifecycle, deterministic agents, persistent storage, audit trail, CLI. Phase 2: persistent memory, provider abstraction, default-deny tool registry, budgets, specialist agents, orchestrator, cancellation and checkpoint/resume. Phase 3: the Chief — goal decomposition into a dependency graph, specialist cards loaded from data files, scope and action enforcement in code, and a verification pass before a mission counts as done.
